verdict.rationale: Statsig's environments guide documents per-environment evaluation of gates, configs and experiments in dev/staging versus production. Environment-specific SDK keys control which rule sets download, and dev, staging and production data are kept separate, which covers independent flag states and scoped keys. Target apps add further SDK-level scoping within a project. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party detail on creating and managing environments (e.g. custom tiers, per-environment toggling workflow), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage separate environments (dev/staging/prod) with independent flag states and scoped SDK keys

citations.quote: evaluate feature gates, dynamic configs, and experiments differently in non-production environments like development or staging
environment-specific SDK keys determining which rule sets download and separated development/staging/production data
Use target apps in Statsig SDKs to scope feature gates, experiments, and dynamic configs to specific applications inside a single project.
